charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but on day 15 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 12:22 and on day 16 at 14:03. It was also at nightstand_b1 at 22:35. The charger is at coffee_table_l1 in the morning (09:00-10:00), mid-day (12:00-15:00), and likely early afternoon. It moves to desk_o1 only in the late afternoon (16:00-17:00) and nightstand_b1 at night (22:00+). Check coffee_table_l1 for any query before 16:00.

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for late afternoon, but on day 16 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 14:48. The bottle is at coffee_table_l1 in the morning (08:00-10:00) and throughout the afternoon (13:00-17:00). It moves to dining_table_d1 in the evening (20:00+). Check coffee_table_l1 for afternoon queries.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for all daytime, but on day 16 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 15:49, confirming the pattern. However, the error log indicates I previously guessed desk_o1 incorrectly. The mug remains at coffee_table_l1 for the entire daytime period (08:00-18:00). Check coffee_table_l1 for all daytime queries.

book_tomas: No new errors today. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for morning queries.

glass_tomas: No new errors today. Keep previous pattern of dining_table_d1 for early evening and nightstand_b1 for very late night.
